method: Release builds from uv sync --locked. Both executables checked the same candidate source tree without build artifacts. One discarded warm-up per workload and binary, then seven alternating runs. Times in seconds include process launch and report rendering. Profiles were collected separately. The operating system file cache was not flushed.

git_object_storage_experiment.method: One candidate binary checked the same committed synthetic corpus and edits in two disposable repositories. The clone was repacked with git repack -adq. Each mode discarded one warm-up per repository, followed by seven samples in alternating order. This experiment is separate from the base/candidate comparison.
